name: singlet_qc_sample_level_qc
title: Sample-level QC pass/fail
description: Flags whole samples or libraries whose summary profile departs from the others, using the per-batch scaled-MAD rule on sample summaries (default) or the SampleQC joint Gaussian-mixture model, which also reports each sample's cell outlier fraction. Needs layers/counts and var/mito; set batch_key when samples are grouped by site or lane. Writes uns/sample_qc with a pass flag per sample and never removes cells or samples. Do not use it to call individual cells or to detect sample swaps or donor mixtures.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

sample_key.description: obs column identifying each sample or library, the unit of the pass or fail decision.

batch_key.description: obs column grouping samples into batches for medians and MADs; null pools all samples into one group.

method.description: mad_batch gives the sample verdict; sampleqc adds cell outlier fractions and sample groups, with a verdict only after calibration.

mad_batch.description: Options for method mad_batch: scaled-MAD rule on sample summaries.

metrics.description: Per-sample summaries compared across samples within each batch.

nmads.description: Scaled MAD multiplier for the flag threshold.

type.description: Tail direction in which a sample can be flagged.

log.description: Apply log2 to count-like summaries (n_cells, median_total_counts, median_genes); mito fraction stays linear.

min_diff.description: Minimum distance from the median before a sample is flagged; null disables the floor.

min_flagged_metrics.description: Number of metrics that must flag a sample; 1 is the union rule, where any flagged metric fails the sample.

sampleqc.description: Options for method sampleqc: joint robust Gaussian mixture with MMD sample groups.

K.description: Mixture components per sample group; start at 1 and check the rendered diagnostics.

alpha.description: Chi-square tail level for the cell outlier cutoff.

mcd_alpha.description: Trimming proportion for the robust MCD-type estimates.

mcd_iters.description: Iterations of the robust MCD-type estimator.

subsample.description: Cells per sample drawn for each MMD distance.

n_times.description: Number of subsampled MMD repetitions per sample pair.

n_cores.description: Parallel workers for the pairwise MMD computation.

include_upstream.description: Report Cell Ranger or MultiQC summaries from uns when present; they never change the verdict.

device.description: Execution device; cuda applies only to the sampleqc EM kernel when available.

seed.description: Random seed for MMD subsampling and MCD resampling in sampleqc.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/sample_qc. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: n_samples, n_failed, failing_samples, method, per_sample (sample, n_cells, flagged metrics, cell outlier fraction), and groups for sampleqc.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
